description.value:
You release a cloud of mood-altering pheromones in a 5-foot sphere around yourself. Every other creature within range must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or take 1d4 poison damage and become frightened of you until the start of its next turn; a creature immune to being poisoned is likewise immune to the fright.

The damage increases to 2d4 at 5th level, 3d4 at 11th level, and 4d4 at 17th level.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, At-Will
